def process(cur, target, pos, sum_arr, pw, OK):
    global result
    if OK:
        return
    if cur == target:
        result = True
        return
    remaining = sum_arr[pos + 1]
    next_val = pw[pos]

    if cur - remaining > target:
        return
    elif cur + remaining < target:
        return
    else:
        if cur + sum_arr[pos] < target:
            process(cur + next_val, target, pos - 1, sum_arr, pw, OK)
        elif cur - sum_arr[pos] > target:
            process(cur - next_val, target, pos - 1, sum_arr, pw, OK)
        else:
            process(cur, target, pos - 1, sum_arr, pw, OK)
